# Katie Steele {#welcome}

Welcome to my portfolio for **MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics** at the
University of Pennsylvania.

This site documents my work in the Master of Data Science program —
weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to
urban policy questions.

## About Me

I'm a student in the Data Science MSE program at Penn; my background is in economics, statistics, and quantitative political science research, and I'm excited to learn more about spatial analysis and apply my skills to new datasets.
